purpose: Expose the resizable-panels behavior library through group, panel and labelled separator components.
behaviorProvider: react-resizable-panels Group, Panel and Separator; Aegis adds styling and collapsed descendant semantics.

requirements.statement: Forward GroupProps through ResizablePanels and PanelProps through ResizablePanel; sizing, pointer gestures and separator keyboard mechanics belong to react-resizable-panels.
Mark a panel inert and aria-hidden when its reported percentage is zero; initialize this state from a zero defaultSize and preserve explicitly supplied inert/aria-hidden values.
Update collapsed state before forwarding each panel onResize callback with size, id and previous values.
Require a label for ResizeHandle and apply it as the separator accessible name; the optional default grip is decorative.
Track pointer-versus-keyboard handle focus for presentation while forwarding supplied capture handlers. This does not replace the primitive keyboard implementation.
Supply compatible direction, panel identifiers, default/min/max sizes and collapsible constraints through the primitive API; give the group a usable bounded layout.
Name each handle for the adjacent content and account for focus when collapsing a panel containing the active control; inert hides descendants but does not implement a product-specific fallback.
Persist and restore layout through host state or the underlying library API when required. The Aegis wrapper does not choose a storage key or save sizes itself.
Own pattern or component styling consumes layout group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: Behavior follows the installed react-resizable-panels version; this contract does not certify every upstream interaction.
No automatic persistence or arbitrary descendant focus handoff on collapse.
All group/panel sizing constraints remain the host responsibility.
